ground_truth.title: 10 DIY Woodworking Projects for Your Home
ground_truth.author: Sarah
ground_truth.main_content:
Adding style and function to your home can be fun, and you can do it yourself! I've shared many ways to update your home on this blog including a budget bathroom makeover and how to make your own wood signs.

Today I've rounded up 10 DIY woodworking projects for your home, most of which you can make in under 2 hours.

These are great for beginners, they require some tools but are not so complicated that you won't be able to complete them.

This post may contain affiliate links, view my full disclosure policy.

The woodworking projects below are all part of the At Home DIY challenge. Each month I share a new DIY project along with a group of very talented blogging friends. We hope to inspire you and show you how to easily update your home.

I picked a handful of projects that I loved this month to share with you here today. I also included a few of my favorite wood projects that have been in use at my house for years.

10 Woodworking Projects for your Home

Check out the full list below. See something you like? Click through for the full post, woodworking plans and lots more details.

Quick Coat Hooks

Photo Credit:
www.littlebitsofhome.com

These genius coat hooks are perfect for little kids! This is one of those 'why didn't I think of that' projects. I am tempted to add them to my kitchen right now.

DIY Plant Stand

Photo Credit:
www.bitterrootdiy.com

A beautiful and simple plant stand is the perfect addition to your deck or patio, and you can complete this woodworking project in under 2 hours!

DIY Mirror Frame

Photo Credit:
www.livingletterhome.com

Upgrade your bathroom mirror for a fraction of the cost of a new one, and in less than 2 hours!

DIY Toilet Paper Holder

Photo Credit:
diydanielle.com

Add some function and style to your bathroom with this simple project. This is sturdy, pretty and functional.

How to Build a Wood Window Cornice

Photo Credit:
thediydreamer.com

Dress up your window without curtains, build a wood cornice that will add character to any window.

DIY Hanging Plant Holder: Make a Wooden Hanging Plant Pot Holder

Photo Credit:
www.bybrittanygoldwyn.com

A simple modern hanging plant holder will add style to any room in your home. This is a simple build that you will want to create more than once.

2 Hour DIY Wood Planter Box

Another simple planter with solid sides that you can stain any color to match your landscape. A potted plant sits right inside this box allowing for easy drainage and the ability to swap it out each season.

DIY House Number Sign

Upgrade a basic address plaque with some fun and bold house numbers. These pieces are pre cut making this a simple wood project to try. This wood sign is sealed to protect it from the elements.

Make a Wood Jewelry Organizer with a Shelf

Display your jewelry and keep it organized with this simple wood project. Only a few cuts and a drill are required for this simple project.

How to Build Paint and Stencil an Outdoor Coffee Table

Build an outdoor coffee table and add a fun stencil, get the plans and more details in this post.

If you like these woodwork projects, pin this image and save it for later.
